note: Selected examples with scan-reviewed wording, not an exhaustive main-branch ranking. Remaining soft-break differences, font weight, historic tap glyph, gray text-box bevel and set-symbol shape remain flagged. Identical per-card face inputs, cached artwork and frame bytes. Each revision uses its own unmodified font stylesheet and renderer. Fixed shared reference alignment; inspection tier only. Main font failures, if present, are recorded rather than silently repaired.

examples.name: Sacrifice
examples.note: The large centered rules policy restores all five printed lines and their endings. Its candidate was frozen before this card was opened for the current study. Original type wording and exact font strokes still need review.

examples.name: Gloom
examples.note: Larger centered rules with balanced lines now match all five printed lines. Both renderers receive the same original wording; fixed frame alignment and existing assets are preserved. Font strokes still differ.

examples.name: Animate Wall
examples.note: A five-line large passage was previously missed by the 100-character cutoff. Shared measured fitting restores the printed word-line endings. Type wording remains modern and is not part of this body score.

examples.name: Earthbind
examples.note: Dense Revised text matches all seven printed lines and their endings. Both renderers now receive the reviewed Enchant Creature type. The title uses thin light/dark edges, and the larger illustrator credit is left-aligned with ©. Mana shapes, type ink and frame texture remain review items. Body classification was audited after refinement; lettering passed separate frozen validation.

examples.name: Gaea's Liege
examples.note: Smaller dense type restores all seven printed lines. Both columns use the reviewed Summon Gaea’s Liege type. Titles and credits use thin paired edges; the credit includes © and stats sit lower against a shared right edge. The diagonal-T mark and body inset are corrected. Frame texture, type ink and exact glyph strokes still differ.

examples.name: Prodigal Sorcerer
examples.note: Shared body inset, narrower width and removal of the rules/flavor gap restore all six printed lines. Both columns use the reviewed Summon Wizard type. Font weight remains heavier; the full-set body regressions remain listed in the review.

examples.name: Dwarven Warriors
examples.note: Shared text bounds restore all five printed lines and move the body upward. The existing diagonal tap mark is retained. No card-specific coordinates or scan transforms.

examples.name: Flashfires
examples.note: Revised uses larger centered type with 30.25px baseline spacing. Both printed lines match; original wording is identical in both rendered columns.

examples.name: Hurricane
examples.note: The Revised policy matches both printed lines. Existing font strokes are heavier than the scan; the shared frame alignment is unchanged.

examples.name: Crusade
examples.note: Larger type and balanced lines reproduce the two-line printing. A shared 348px text box also prevents excess wrapping on longer single-line passages.

examples.name: Fear
examples.note: Larger centered rules text with balanced line lengths. The shared 344px width preserves the three printed lines; the narrower trial incorrectly added a fourth.

examples.name: Healing Salve
examples.note: The shared Fourth Edition typography policy matches all three printed lines, using the original wording on both sides.

examples.name: Uncle Istvan
examples.note: Title, mana, credits and stats; the text now sits inside the black panel and uses the printed line breaks.

examples.name: Angry Mob
examples.note: Original printed wording and Summon Mob type on both sides. Corrected body inset and paragraph spacing, plus mana, credits and wide stats.

examples.name: Shaper Guildmage
examples.note: Text layout, mana row, historic tap and outlined set symbol.

examples.name: Grindstone
examples.note: Historic tap, set-symbol outline, text and legal line.

examples.name: Island
examples.note: Historical Land type and centered mana sentence replace the large symbol.

examples.name: Sol Ring
examples.note: The diagonal-T tap mark now matches Revised’s symbol identity using the existing font. All three printed lines match. Font stroke weight and the exact symbol outline remain useful review details.

examples.name: Righteousness
examples.note: Remaining review case: centering and size improve, but “gets” still starts the second line instead of ending the first. No scan-specific line break is supplied to the painter.

examples.name: Mtenda Herder
examples.note: The white-frame text box is 10 canonical pixels wider; all seven printed lines now match with the same fonts. Gray bevel on the left/bottom is baked into the frame asset and remains flagged.
